text.en: If your card expires before the result comes out, go to the ward office before it expires. Bring your My Number Card, your residence card, and the "pending" stamp (if you applied online, the acceptance-complete email from Immigration). The extension covers only the waiting period (up to 2 months) and cannot be extended again. When you receive the new residence card, go back and update the card expiry. Nagoya accepts the acceptance-complete email.
